findings.finding: MDTraj DCD reader substitutes frame indices for physical time; imports initially labelled these as ps without warning.
findings.evidence: A two/three-frame DCD fixture loaded as 0,1,... regardless of intended .1/.25 ps interval.
findings.resolution: Reader-unavailable timestamp warning and explicit user interval; metadata/UI frame-axis support under implementation.

findings.finding: Advertised HDF5 import unavailable without PyTables.
findings.evidence: mdtraj HDF5 writer/import raises missing PyTables exception.

findings.finding: PDB trajectory with same atom count but changed atom order could inherit mismatched supplied topology.
findings.resolution: Compare self-describing trajectory atom signatures before replacing topology.

findings.finding: MDTraj iterload lacks PDBxTrajectoryFile.read_as_traj, breaking advertised mmCIF topology imports.
findings.resolution: Use supported format-specific eager loading for mmCIF with caps.

findings.finding: Ordinary arithmetic mean is misleading across torsion ±180-degree branch cut; plotted connecting segment also implies a long angular change.
findings.resolution: Hide torsion mean or use circular mean; split plot at wraps.

findings.finding: Equal frame spacing with physical time labels distorts nonuniform timestamps.
findings.resolution: Plot against actual times with nearest-time seek, or explicitly use frame index axis.

findings.finding: Cartesian interpolation of wrapped coordinates can create artificial periodic crossing paths.
findings.resolution: Periodic trajectories use saved-frame playback; numeric analysis always uses saved physical frames.

findings.finding: The initial bundled OpenMM demo preceded Python/NumPy preparation RNG controls.
findings.resolution: Provenance explicitly records uncontrolled preparation randomness; prepared coordinates and engine artifacts retained. New jobs seed preparation RNGs; exact replay of old demo not claimed.

findings.finding: Unrestricted solvent neutralization could select input crystal waters; a restricted selection initially used a group name incompatible with nonzero genion replacement.
findings.resolution: Only newly added water atoms are eligible. Full workflow and a separate one-Na/one-Cl replacement check passed, preserving all 1,231 input atoms. See engine-smoke-checks.json.
